exposure: Copper intrauterine device (IUD) insertion during cesarean delivery
copper intrauterine devices (IUDs) placement during cesarean delivery
cohort: Women who received a copper IUD during cesarean delivery
finding: While 59% of copper IUDs placed during cesarean delivery were correctly positioned at 6 months, nearly one third were malpositioned.
mod_finding: The study focused on copper intrauterine device (IUD) placement during cesarean delivery and did not examine other modes of delivery.
